content: pnpm.io/installation (fetched 2026-09-10) no longer documents corepack at all — recommended methods are the standalone script (get.pnpm.io), npx get-pnpm (needs Node 22.13+ for installer), and pnpm self-update (11.10.0+). pnpm 12 is a native executable not requiring Node. packageManager field still governs the pinned version when corepack is available. Implication: corepack-based install (locked decision) works on Node 24 today but is no longer pnpm's recommended path; standalone script is the fallback documented in the runbook.
